evidence: Existing AppleContainerBackend::probe creates task=None; capabilities.shell/persistent_filesystem and configured are false until a real scoped task context. A CLI probe is not a native-worker capability registration
decision: Register the actual verified GuestOmp runtime as its distinct backend, apple-native-omp. Do not fabricate a for_task execution/preview directory, set probe capabilities true, mutate the existing ComputerBackend trait or create another registry/home store
registry_type: pub struct NativeWorkerBackendFacts { pub configured: bool, pub available: bool }; defined by D in registry.rs, reexported by Root through computers/mod.rs
registry_api: ComputerRegistry::register_native_worker_backend(&mut self, facts: NativeWorkerBackendFacts, accepted_capabilities: Vec<String>) -> anyhow::Result<()>
registration: Existing RegisteredBackend must preserve dynamically observed ComputerBackend behavior and separately represent native-worker facts (boring enum). Native backend identity is exactly apple-native-omp and offered capability set is exactly shell+persistent_filesystem, with browser/human_control false. Configured means validated actual native runner/runtime/source/model/tool route, not mere CLI installation; available comes from actual read-only service probe. Reject available=true/configured=false or unoffered trusted acceptance. Existing downgrade/current/lease logic consumes both registration kinds without granting or changing bindings
factory_rules: C validates the same selected native GuestOmp config, canonical immutable source snapshot and pinned Linux ARM64/OMP runtime/tool/model route before reporting configured. Probe Apple CLI/service read-only once per registered runner. Preserve no fallback/global auth/config/automatic retry. Do not clone/revalidate config unnecessarily, spawn a VM, call a model, create an execution or infer availability from configuration. A missing/invalid prerequisite is an error, not configured=true
consumer: C registers these real factory facts on the existing shared registry handle before acquire_worker_home. Root Host reads the exact configured per-Ghost runner_config and invokes the same factory before provisioning or issuing grants, not a separate pseudo backend

ownership.C: Only CNativeTools1 existing worker allowlist; factory and real registration consumer
ownership.D: Only DHome2 registry.rs and owned behavioral tests; new facts type/registration variant and shared current/lease checks
ownership.root: computers/mod.rs reexport; Host config/grant/routing; contracts and all build/runtime verification

invalid native runtime/source route reports no configured capability
